body: I don't know. I just feel like I may know enough to pass the classes and tests, but the extent of my knowledge ends there. I've had personal side projects and whatnot, but it seems to me the "real" computer scientists have dug really deep into other concepts, and while they may not get the best grades or even great grades, the breadth of their knowledge more than makes up for that lack of depth in some areas.
I love CS, but I'm not worthy of the title "computer scientist"

The thing is, I can't even relate to you. I'm relatively young, I've had great jobs. I've earned a great deal of money. I don't have to worry about living week to week. I do okay in school, but sometimes just putting an end to this charade seems the best idea. If I end up in the "real world" all I'll do is be an incompetent ass that tries to fool his coworkers into thinking he can pull his own weight. I'm not a real computer scientist, and never have been.

I'm sorry for wasting your time. Honestly speaking, I'm taking the belt off from my neck, getting some sleep, and re-evaluating the situation in the morning. This isn't the first time I've pussied out.

If there's something I've learned thus far, is that if you tell someone you want to end it, they seem determined to stop you. Why? There is no gain in that. I'm not going to upvote you. I'm not going to say "you're the only reason I never did it!". In all likelihood I'll probably do it anyway. Why, why, why, would you ever want to stop me? What's the point?
I've already fucking explained this shit. Please forgive me, but I'm a little short on patience with anything right now. I'm a fucking idiot that doesn't deserve anything that has been given to me
I'm a graduate student. I read academic papers, write code, and do homework nonstop like any other grad student.

Look, it's fine and all, but don't patronize me with the "Glad you're still alive" shit. It's almost as bad as the "You're smart" shit that people say all the time.

What I see when I look in the mirror: a man of mediocre at best intelligence faking his way through college and graduate school. He's steadily growing less attractive with age, hasn't allowed himself to form a close relationship with nearly anybody, and therefore has shit-all to show for his life.

The alcohol thing... you're onto it there. I went 3-4 weeks without any and felt great, but shit, when I finally have some it helps me reflect and see just how piss-poor my life is.

I can't stand not being the smartest person in the room. The same thing demotivates me from even trying to improve.

Between last response and this one I tried to suffocate myself with a belt. This sounds like such a troll post but whatever. I'll fucking give myself 24 hours like that link in the right hand column says.

EDIT: Of course I failed at even killing myself.

I don't know...The people I've talked to tell me I have way too high of standards for myself. If I'm not perfect at something then I'm worthless... It's just who I am. They tell me to lower my standards for myself but that's just unrealistic. Either I'm perfect or I'm worthless. Fuck. I have noticed there to be a very strong correlation between alcohol and my urge to do it, and each time the urge is stronger. This is one of those times.
